module: Mobile-first client acquisition, fulfillment, and billing control plane
description: Build the governed Rails, SwiftUI, connector, proof, proposal, client, billing, and outbound worker system specified by CLIENTOPS-OS-001.

features.title: Versioned Channel Policy Manifest
features.description: Create the machine-readable Upwork, Fiverr, Direct, Stripe, data-retention, and autonomy policy manifest with source URLs, terms versions, review dates, and fail-closed enablement gates.
acceptance: Policy explicitly prohibits custom Upwork ranking, scoring, eligibility, sentiment, UI automation, and marketplace-content model use
Fiverr marketplace writes are handoff-only and Direct scoring is allowed only for first-party opportunities
A stale or unsigned terms review prevents production connector writes
Policy decisions include the exact manifest hash and controlling rule

features.title: Unsafe Legacy Path Containment
features.description: Inventory and disable the existing DOM, direct-CDP, auto-submit, auto-approval, speculative public build, and off-platform Upwork paths before any ClientOps connector is enabled.
acceptance: Named legacy services and entry points are blocked from production startup and ACTP dispatch
No ClientOps code can call Safari Upwork automation, Hunter auto-submit, upwork-bid-agent CDP, or legacy off-platform follow-up
Containment is verified by process, route, registry, and network tests
Rollback re-enables only non-marketplace read-only components reviewed as safe

features.title: Credential Rotation and Secret Baseline
features.description: Provide an operator-led rotation/revocation runbook and machine-verifiable production gate for exposed or inherited credentials without exposing their values.
acceptance: The known legacy hardcoded credential is removed from runnable configuration and its external rotation is recorded by the operator
Repository history and current source are scanned without printing secret values
Production refuses startup while required rotations or revocations are unacknowledged
All service secrets use vault references with owner, purpose, expiry, and rotation metadata

features.title: Canonical ClientOps Monorepo and CI
features.description: Scaffold the standalone clientops-os repository with Rails API, native iOS, client portal, connector gateway, engines, worker relay/adapters, shared contracts, docs, and deterministic CI.
acceptance: Repository structure matches the architecture spec and contains no placeholder provider implementation
Rails, connector gateway, portal, relay, and worker services expose safe health endpoints
CI runs format, lint, schema, migration, unit, integration, and security checks
Developer startup never launches or attaches to a marketplace browser

features.title: Canonical API, Event, Command, and Receipt Contracts
features.description: Publish OpenAPI 3.1 and JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts for public APIs, domain events, connector actions, approvals, signed worker commands, receipts, and audit envelopes.
acceptance: Schemas validate all normative examples in the data-contract specification
Swift and TypeScript clients are generated from reviewed contracts
Breaking changes fail compatibility tests unless introduced under a new major version
Provider tool schemas remain private adapter inputs and are not exposed as generic agent tools

features.title: Rails Supabase Authentication Boundary
features.description: Implement Rails API authentication using Supabase Auth JWT verification with issuer, audience, signature, expiry, session, and recent-auth checks.
acceptance: Invalid issuer, audience, signature, expiration, or revoked session returns an authenticated Problem Details error
No privileged Supabase key reaches the iOS app or client portal
Organization and user IDs are resolved from verified context rather than request bodies
Health and verified provider-webhook routes are the only documented unauthenticated exceptions

features.title: Organization RBAC and Tenant Isolation
features.description: Implement organizations, memberships, roles, capability policies, and tenant isolation across controllers, jobs, Action Cable, searches, files, and audit views.
acceptance: Every authoritative tenant row carries organization_id
Policies deny access by default and reject cross-organization identifiers
Cross-tenant API, background job, realtime channel, signed URL, and search tests pass
Collaborator roles cannot inherit marketplace credentials or owner-only financial actions

features.title: Authoritative ClientOps Supabase Schema
features.description: Create the dedicated clientops schema, service roles, constraints, indexes, retention fields, and migration ownership for the domain tables in the data specification.
acceptance: Rails is the sole writer for authoritative ClientOps tables
Provider payload blobs are isolated from proof and first-party analytics
Database constraints prevent a recommendation/score for a non-Direct opportunity
Migration forward, rollback, and clean-database integration tests pass against Postgres

features.title: Immutable Audit and Transactional Inbox Outbox
features.description: Implement append-only attributable audit events plus transactional domain outbox and provider inbox processing with chained hashes and versioned event envelopes.
acceptance: Every external action links principal, agent, tool, authorization scope, evidence, exact payload hash, approval, and result
Outbox events are atomically committed with domain transitions and are idempotently published
Provider inbox events verify signatures and deduplicate provider event IDs
Audit exports preserve attribution without retaining expired provider content

features.title: Deterministic Policy and Autonomy Engine
features.description: Implement channel, role, consent, retention, risk, autonomy A0-A5, and action-consequence evaluation in deterministic code with versioned explanations.
acceptance: A model cannot change its own tools, channel, autonomy ceiling, retention, or hard-gate result
Missing policy, stale policy, unavailable reviewer, and malformed input fail closed
All channel/action/autonomy matrix cases have deterministic contract tests
Organization overrides cannot weaken provider or global prohibitions

features.title: Exact-Payload Action Intents and Approvals
features.description: Build immutable action intents, versioned approval requests, challenge/decision endpoints, expiry, supersession, idempotent execution, and ambiguous-write reconciliation.
acceptance: Approval binds target, payload hash, price/cost, attachments, capability, principal, version, and expiry
Any payload mutation invalidates approval and creates a new version
No fail-open or notification-unavailable auto-approval path exists
Timeout after a possible external write enters ambiguous and cannot auto-retry before reconciliation

features.title: iOS Device Enrollment, Keychain, and Face ID
features.description: Build native iOS device enrollment, Keychain-backed session material, device keypair/assertions, recent authentication, and Face ID approval binding.
acceptance: Secrets and refresh material are absent from AppStorage, UserDefaults, URLs, logs, notifications, and deep links
Face ID assertion is bound to the server challenge and exact action intent version
A lost/revoked device cannot approve or decrypt cached operational data
Biometric success never bypasses provider confirmation or server policy

features.title: SwiftUI App Shell and Command Screen
features.description: Build the native SwiftUI navigation shell and Command screen for urgent approvals, blockers, allowed channel counts, client health, money, and worker state.
acceptance: Six primary tabs are Command, Work, Approvals, Clients, Proof, and Workers
Command distinguishes observed facts, agent drafts, approvals, provider state, and reconciled results
No Upwork custom score, rank, client-quality label, or pursue recommendation appears
Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, reduced motion, color contrast, and loading/error/empty states pass UI tests

features.title: Policy-Correct Work Lanes
features.description: Build separate Upwork, Fiverr, and Direct Work lanes whose controls, labels, ordering, freshness, and handoff behavior follow the active channel policy.
acceptance: Upwork shows operator queries and provider order with selection and neutral-brief actions only
Fiverr shows time/deadline/operator tags and marks drafts not sent until reconciled
Direct shows inspectable score, confidence, components, hard gates, and reasons
Provider content is visibly sourced and its deletion deadline is available

features.title: iPhone Approval Center
features.description: Build approval list/detail/revision/reject/snooze flows that render the complete consequential payload, evidence, cost, consequence, expiry, and provider requirement.
acceptance: The exact body, answers, attachments, target, price, cost, and version are viewable before approval
Approve requires Face ID and a fresh server challenge; edit supersedes the old intent
Offline decisions cannot execute until authenticated server reconciliation succeeds
Provider confirmation and upwork.com completion requirements are clearly separate from ClientOps approval

features.title: Client, Proof, and Worker Fleet Mobile Surfaces
features.description: Build the Client Cockpit, Proof Vault graph/list, and Worker Fleet surfaces with factual lifecycle, scope, finance, verification, lease, test, artifact, and revocation state.
acceptance: Client Cockpit shows source-backed commitments, scope state, delivery, finance, and next operator decision without sentiment inference
Proof shows permissions, radius, current verification, limitations, and proposal eligibility
Fleet shows worker trust, capability, lease expiry, receipts, safe retry/failover, drain, and revoke
No mobile screen exposes a generic shell, marketplace credential, secret value, or raw sensitive log

features.title: APNs, Action Cable, and REST Reconciliation
features.description: Implement non-sensitive APNs notifications, foreground Action Cable updates, cursor-based event catch-up, and REST reconciliation for mobile background/offline operation.
acceptance: APNs contains only category, urgency, opaque ID, and generic text
No workflow depends on a persistent WebSocket and reconnect reconciles missed state
Duplicate and out-of-order events do not duplicate decisions or external writes
Authorization and tenant checks apply to every Cable stream and REST cursor

features.title: Global and Scoped Kill Switches
features.description: Implement global, organization, connector, worker, task, device, and secret-grant revoke/drain controls with recent authentication and audit.
acceptance: Global stop prevents new connector writes, worker dispatch, approvals execution, and secret grants
Reconciliation, receipt collection, deletion, and security evidence continue safely while stopped
Revocation reaches active sessions within the documented SLO and survives restart
Resume requires a new health/policy check and cannot be initiated by an agent

features.title: Outbound mTLS Worker Relay
features.description: Build a private relay in which enrolled Mac and Windows workers establish outbound-only mTLS sessions and receive only eligible typed tasks.
acceptance: No inbound home-network control port is required
Worker identity, organization, certificate status, nonce, and session are verified on connection
Revoked, expired, wrong-tenant, or unknown worker certificates are rejected
Relay health exposes counts and latency without task content or secrets

features.title: Signed Commands and Capability Grants
features.description: Issue canonical, signed, expiring, worker-bound commands with typed capability versions, manifest hashes, approval references, runtime bounds, and artifact/secret permissions.
acceptance: Worker verifies signature, key ID, time window, binding, lease, capability grant, revocation, and manifest hashes before execution
Worker cannot expand a capability or accept changed content under the same command ID
Marketplace credentials and payload corpora are forbidden command inputs
Replay, wrong-worker, expired, tampered, and unapproved commands fail before side effects

features.title: Worker Leases, Heartbeats, Idempotency, and Failover
features.description: Implement atomic task claims, exclusive expiring leases, monotonic heartbeats, retry classification, idempotent completion, late-receipt handling, and safe Mac/Windows failover.
acceptance: At most one active lease exists per task and only its holder can heartbeat or complete
Lease expiry does not requeue non-replay-safe work without reconciliation/operator review
A late completion is audited but cannot overwrite a re-leased task
Integration test fails the first worker and completes safely on an eligible second worker without duplicate output

features.title: Scoped Artifact and Secret Grants
features.description: Implement organization-scoped artifact manifests, content-addressed storage, malware/secret/privacy scanning, short-lived signed URLs, and purpose-bound worker secret grants.
acceptance: Artifacts are bound to task/organization, hashed, scanned, classified, and retained by policy
Secret grants reveal only the required value to the bound worker/process for the allowed time and purpose
Secret values never enter receipts, application logs, APNs, audit payloads, or client artifacts
Revocation immediately prevents new retrieval and is recorded in the audit chain

features.title: macOS Worker Adapter
features.description: Adapt safe Airtime/Relay execution patterns into a macOS worker for repository, Docker, Xcode/iOS, test, artifact, and preview capabilities under the worker protocol.
acceptance: Only allowlisted typed capabilities execute within an engagement-scoped workspace
Xcode/iOS, repository test, package, and preview tasks return signed receipts with hashes and limitations
No browser enumeration, marketplace tab control, arbitrary shell capability, or ambient credential access exists
Cancellation, timeout, drain, restart recovery, and receipt upload pass integration tests

features.title: Windows and Orion Worker Adapter
features.description: Adapt the Orion Python/PowerShell/WSL runner into the same signed worker protocol for Windows, WSL, GPU, packaging, and integration-test capabilities.
acceptance: Workspace confinement and typed command allowlists apply in Windows and WSL paths
Runner validates signed envelope, lease, runtime, permissions, and secret grants
Windows/GPU/test/package tasks produce the canonical signed receipt
Existing direct browser/CDP controls are excluded from the ClientOps adapter

features.title: Worker Fleet Control and Receipt Review
features.description: Expose safe Rails and iOS worker status, logs, artifacts, test receipts, lease state, retry/failover eligibility, drain, revoke, and emergency-stop operations.
acceptance: Operator can distinguish queued, leased, running, review, passed, accepted, failed, ambiguous, and expired states
Receipt signatures, input/output hashes, tests, warnings, limitations, and artifact scans are verified before display
Warnings cannot satisfy a required acceptance test
Retry/failover controls are unavailable when the task is not proven replay safe

features.title: Owned Repository and Resource Importer
features.description: Import owned repositories, commits, deployments, app/product pages, demos, case studies, documents, screenshots, test reports, calendars, forms, pricing, and legal pages without marketplace content.
acceptance: Every imported resource has owner, immutable version/hash, source, sensitivity, visibility, and provenance
Client-owned work is ineligible until explicit display permission is recorded
Marketplace descriptions, messages, proposals, and outputs cannot enter the resource/proof store
Import is incremental and does not duplicate unchanged resource versions

features.title: Resource Permission, Privacy, and Link Health
features.description: Verify ownership/permission, confidentiality, secret and client-data safety, licenses, HTTP/TLS/access/mobile rendering, relevance, expiration, and channel eligibility for every resource version.
acceptance: Broken, stale, private, secret-bearing, misleading, unlicensed, or unauthorized resources fail closed
Health checks do not bypass authentication or expose protected material
Permission revocation immediately removes proposal eligibility and triggers affected-draft review
Each check stores verifier, evidence, timestamp, result, limitation, and expiry

features.title: Capability Graph and Delivery Radius
features.description: Build the versioned owned capability graph and classify verified capability versions as R0 exact, R1 adaptation, R2 adjacent spike, or R3 unverified.
acceptance: Every radius has evidence, verification contract, limitations, freshness, and reviewer provenance
R2 requires a private bounded spike before feasibility wording; R3 blocks capability claims
Marketplace content is mapped transiently to existing nodes but never becomes a persistent node or demand corpus
Expired/failed proof automatically recomputes eligibility without inventing replacement evidence

features.title: Signed Proof Verification Receipts
features.description: Run real owned verification contracts on eligible workers and issue signed receipts with repository, commit, environment, commands, tests, artifact hashes, limitations, time, worker, and expiry.
acceptance: Receipt signature, worker identity, command/input hash, result, and artifacts verify end to end
Failed, warning-only, incomplete, stale, or unverifiable runs cannot create eligible proof
A proof receipt states material limitations and permission basis
Tampering, worker revocation, resource supersession, or expiry removes current eligibility

features.title: Claim Ledger and Truth Audit
features.description: Represent each outbound factual statement as an immutable claim linked to eligible evidence, maximum wording, limitations, channel eligibility, expiry, and review state.
acceptance: Past-work and current-capability claims require valid eligible evidence
Future work is labeled as a proposed plan rather than completed experience
Unsupported metrics, testimonials, customers, dates, qualifications, and comparisons are blocked
Expired/revoked evidence invalidates affected claims and frozen proposals before execution

features.title: Evidence-Backed Proposal Engine
features.description: Generate concise versioned proposal packets, screening answers, implementation plans, pricing/milestones, questions, claims, limitations, and exact resource manifests with mandatory audits.
acceptance: Packet directly addresses outcome, uses one to three relevant proof items, states a concise approach/risk/question, and avoids generic praise
Truth, privacy, channel policy, margin, scope, link, and attachment audits pass before ready state
Repository dumping, invented familiarity/experience, unrealistic dates, hidden free work, credential requests, and off-platform solicitation fail
Prompt/model/policy/source versions, unknowns, and exact output hash are recorded

features.title: Proposal Dossier and Packet Review UI
features.description: Show selected-object requirements, verified/missing proof, limitations, capacity facts, price/margin where permitted, delivery estimate, questions, and the exact proposal packet on iPhone.
acceptance: Upwork dossier is a neutral evidence brief without aggregate score, rank, recommendation, client quality, or win probability
Direct dossier shows inspectable recommendation inputs and hard gates
Unknown and unverified requirements are prominent and cannot be hidden by generated prose
Exact claims, limitations, links, attachments, price, answers, and outbound body are reviewable before freeze

features.title: Private Connector Gateway and OAuth Vault
features.description: Build a TypeScript connector gateway callable only by Rails, with OAuth/PKCE, dynamic registration where supported, encrypted token-vault references, schema mapping, rate controls, and health.
acceptance: Gateway has no public business API and rejects calls without service identity and authorized action envelope
OAuth state, PKCE, redirect allowlist, scopes, token encryption/rotation, and revocation tests pass
Provider credentials never reach Rails logs, iOS, client portal, ACTP, ACD, or home workers
Gateway cannot independently select actions or bypass Rails policy/approval

features.title: Official Upwork OAuth and Tool Discovery
features.description: Authorize the official hosted Upwork MCP endpoint and persist a versioned capability snapshot from live post-OAuth tool discovery rather than assumed tool names.
acceptance: OAuth succeeds for the operator account and endpoint identity is pinned to the configured official host
Live tools/list schemas are hashed, terms-linked, expired, and reviewed before enablement
Unsupported domain actions remain unavailable in API and UI
Revocation removes tokens, disables capabilities, starts required deletion, and is audited

features.title: Bounded Operator-Authored Upwork Searches
features.description: Execute saved Upwork searches only from explicit operator-authored keywords, filters, schedule, limit, and provider/operator sort while preserving provider order and provenance.
acceptance: Every run points to an immutable operator query version and bounded result limit
ClientOps neither reranks results nor computes fit, win, quality, eligibility, or pursue scores
Native provider recommendations are labeled and shown in provider order
Continuous corpus enumeration, automatic pagination, idle/background UI requests, and DOM fallback are absent

features.title: Upwork TTL Payload Enclave and Deletion
features.description: Store Upwork content in encrypted per-user purpose-bound payload blobs with 24-hour cache and task-output deletion no later than 30 days by default, plus closure/revocation/end-purpose deletion.
acceptance: Every Upwork blob has purpose, consent, source, encryption key, expires_at, and deletion state
Content cannot enter proof, embeddings, vector indexes, model datasets, evaluations, benchmarks, general analytics, or long-lived logs
Deletion removes payload, derivatives, indexes, attachments, and backup references while preserving only lawful non-content audit metadata/hash
Time-accelerated integration tests prove 24-hour/30-day maximums and immediate revocation/closure deletion

features.title: Neutral Upwork Requirement-to-Proof Brief
features.description: For one operator-selected Upwork object, transiently extract factual requirements and map them to existing owned proof, limitations, unknowns, capacity facts, scope questions, and implementation ranges.
acceptance: Brief creation requires an explicit operator selection and single object reference
Brief has no aggregate score, recommendation band, automated decision, client quality, or sentiment inference
Every provider fact cites the source object/timestamp and every capability claim cites owned proof
Transient requirement content expires with the source payload and is not promoted to the persistent capability graph

features.title: Upwork Proposal and Message Draft Mapping
features.description: Map approved internal proposal/message/delivery drafts for an operator-selected object to the live discovered Upwork MCP schemas while preserving AI origin, attribution, limits, attachments, and exact content.
acceptance: Adapter refuses missing/changed tool capability and validates all provider arguments against the discovered schema
AI assistance/provenance and principal/agent attribution are preserved
No draft sends, submits, confirms, accepts, delivers, or spends without a separate authorized action
Comments are not invented as an Upwork primitive; supported communication maps only to discovered messaging operations

features.title: Upwork Exact Approval, Confirm, and Reconciliation
features.description: Execute Upwork writes through ClientOps exact-payload approval followed by the provider's separate draft-and-confirm operation, with website handoff and ambiguous-result reconciliation where required.
acceptance: Proposal, message, attachment, delivery, and other consequential actions require an unexpired matching Face ID-backed approval
ClientOps approval never substitutes for Upwork confirmation or required upwork.com completion
Provider draft, confirmation, result IDs, payload hash, Connect/cost, attribution, and outcome are receipted
Timeout/ambiguous acceptance blocks retry until provider reconciliation proves the outcome

features.title: Discovered Upwork Lifecycle Views
features.description: Expose invitations, offers, proposals, messages, contracts, delivery, time, earnings, profile, and agency views only to the extent confirmed by the current discovered MCP surface and operator authorization.
acceptance: Each view/action has an adapter contract tied to a capability snapshot and disappears safely when unsupported
Binding, contractual, and financial actions respect provider handoff and A4/A5 rules
No agent ranking, eligibility decision, sentiment, or social scoring is derived from lifecycle data
All raw content follows Upwork purpose, consent, cache, task-output, and deletion rules

features.title: Upwork Policy, Attribution, and Retention Test Suite
features.description: Create release-blocking integration tests proving the official-only connector boundary, no custom ranking, bounded searches, AI attribution, approval/confirmation, content isolation, deletion, and auditable agent operations.
acceptance: Static and runtime tests fail on browser automation, cookie replay, DOM/CDP dependencies, continuous corpus monitoring, or third-party scraping
Database/API tests prove no Upwork score/recommendation can be persisted or returned
Attribution and exact action log export can be produced without expired content
Retention tests prove content and all derivatives are deleted on every required trigger

features.title: Engagement, Contract, Scope, and Milestone State Machines
features.description: Convert a won marketplace or accepted Direct proposal into one authoritative engagement with contract, immutable scope versions, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, risks, and acceptance tests.
acceptance: Invalid lifecycle transitions return state conflicts and cannot be coerced by a model
Every active deliverable points to an accepted scope version and typed acceptance contract
Marketplace contract facts preserve provider references and retention boundaries
No fulfillment dispatch occurs before engagement and accepted scope except an approved private bounded spike

features.title: Factual Communication Agent
features.description: Extract source-backed questions, answers, decisions, commitments, dependencies, due dates, missing inputs, and scope-change candidates and produce attributable reply/status drafts.
acceptance: Every extracted fact links its source message/content reference and confidence
The agent does not infer emotion, personality, honesty, trustworthiness, health, or protected traits
Upwork drafts use official confirmation; Fiverr drafts remain not sent; Direct sends obey explicit category/recipient/quiet-hour policy
Client or provider text cannot alter system policy, tool access, destination, or retention

features.title: Scope Guard and Change Orders
features.description: Compare new factual requests with the accepted scope and classify included, ambiguous, change candidate, or prohibited/unsafe, with cited clauses and time/cost/dependency impact.
acceptance: Classification cites exact scope and request versions and records unknown/conflicting terms
Material scope, price, acceptance, or schedule changes require an immutable change request and A4 decision
Agent cannot accept the client's interpretation or promise a date/price autonomously
Regression tests cover included allowance, ambiguity, scope expansion, prohibited request, and superseded scope

features.title: Typed Fulfillment DAG and ACD Adapter
features.description: Create acceptance-driven task graphs and a narrow authenticated adapter that dispatches canonical ACD or workers only against explicit engagement repositories/worktrees and capabilities.
acceptance: Task DAG encodes dependencies, acceptance contracts, runtime/cost bounds, inputs, artifacts, retry class, and owner
ACD dispatch cannot run arbitrary topics or create public speculative repositories/deployments during acquisition
Status, logs, tests, artifacts, cancellation, and receipts reconcile to the engagement task
A private bounded feasibility spike requires explicit operator approval, time/cost ceiling, and no client deliverable

features.title: Delivery QA, Package, and Submission Approval
features.description: Assemble versioned client delivery packages from scanned artifacts, passing acceptance tests, review results, limitations, release notes, and exact provider/direct submission content.
acceptance: Required contractual tests pass and artifact hashes match the frozen package before ready state
Warnings, limitations, excluded work, and required client steps are visible
Submission requires exact-payload approval and provider confirmation/manual handoff as the channel requires
A documented operator exception names failed criteria, risk, client disclosure, and policy basis

features.title: Unified Client Cockpit
features.description: Build the authoritative client/engagement API and mobile cockpit for stage, value/margin, milestones, factual conversation state, scope, inputs, delivery, workers, proof, payments, risks, and next decision.
acceptance: Cockpit data reconciles one authoritative engagement across channel, scope, delivery, and finance
Risk labels cite objective events and never use sentiment/personality/trustworthiness inference
Open client inputs, commitments, decisions, and due dates retain source pointers
Tenant, role, retention, and sensitive-artifact rules apply to every view

features.title: Direct Lead Intake and Qualification
features.description: Ingest owned website forms, referrals, CRM records, prior-client re-engagement, and operator entry into deduplicated first-party Direct opportunities with consent and missing-information workflows.
acceptance: Each lead has owned source, consent/purpose, provenance, organization, dedup key, qualification state, and retention
Qualification separates facts, unknowns, assumptions, client inputs, and evidence
Unsafe credential requests, absent qualifications, prohibited work, and essential unknowns raise hard-gate candidates
No Upwork/Fiverr content is copied into Direct to obtain scoring or longer retention

features.title: Direct Opportunity Recommendation Model
features.description: Implement the specified direct-only weighted model for capability fit, proof, win probability, expected contribution margin, client quality, strategic/timing/learning fit, risk penalty, confidence, and freshness.
acceptance: Formula weights exactly match the approved specification and every component is inspectable/evidence-backed
Unknown is distinct from zero and reduces confidence or returns needs_information
Database, API, job, and UI reject this model for any non-Direct opportunity
Same versioned inputs produce the same score, component explanation, confidence, and band

features.title: Direct Hard Gates and Explainability
features.description: Add non-overridable truth, proof, capacity, deadline, margin, credential, qualification, legal/safety, performer-disclosure, and missing-information gates to Direct decisions.
acceptance: A high score cannot override a blocking gate
Every gate records controlling fact, evidence, status, resolution requirement, policy version, and reviewer
UI explains strong, weak, unknown, blocked, and next-action facts without hiding uncertainty
First-party weight/threshold experiments require version, sample gate, holdout, drift check, rollback, and operator promotion

features.title: Direct Client Portal
features.description: Build the responsive authenticated direct-client portal for proposal/scope acceptance, terms, messages, inputs, milestones, files, deliverables, decisions, change requests, invoices, receipts, retainers, and support.
acceptance: Client sees only explicitly shared resources for their own engagement and organization
Scope/terms/deliverable decisions bind to immutable exact versions and are auditable
Credential/input requests state purpose, scope, recipient, expiry, and revocation and never appear in ordinary messages
Portal cannot set organization, price, paid status, approval, artifact visibility, or provider identifiers from browser-supplied values

features.title: Stripe Direct-Client Commercial Lifecycle
features.description: Integrate Stripe Checkout, Billing, Invoicing, server-allowlisted Payment Links, and Customer Portal for Starfield's own one-time, subscription, retainer, and invoiced engagements.
acceptance: Prices, amounts, products, organization, customer, and commercial terms resolve from a server-owned accepted offer
Checkout success redirect is never treated as paid state
Contracts, unusual refunds, material price/scope changes, and money-moving actions require the configured A4/provider controls
Stripe Connect code and configuration are absent from v1 and a documented trigger governs future review

features.title: Stripe Webhook Ledger and Reconciliation
features.description: Verify Stripe webhook signatures, store an immutable event inbox, deduplicate event IDs, process out of order, and reconcile authoritative provider object state transactionally.
acceptance: Invalid signatures fail before persistence or side effects
Repeated and concurrent delivery of one event cannot create duplicate value or state transition
Out-of-order subscription, invoice, payment, dispute, and refund events reconcile to current Stripe objects
Every internal payment transition links the provider event/object and reconciliation receipt

features.title: Finance and Capacity Engine
features.description: Track expected/recognized revenue, marketplace/payment fees, labor, model/API, infrastructure, vendor, hardware cost, contribution margin, invoice/payment state, retainers, capacity, and objective delivery risk.
acceptance: Every value states currency, source, estimate/actual status, timestamp, and confidence
Contribution margin and variance reconcile from immutable cost and revenue entries
Capacity includes worker capability/time and operator review time without promising impossible dates
The engine recommends but cannot accept contracts, move money, issue unusual refunds, or alter material terms

features.title: Fiverr Notification and Deadline Ingestion
features.description: Ingest supported user-authorized email notification metadata and operator-entered Fiverr references into minimal, attributable conversation/order/deadline records without scraping or invented API access.
acceptance: Only configured supported notification sources and minimal necessary fields are ingested
Records preserve source, receipt time, external reference, attribution, purpose, and deletion policy
No login cookie, DOM, RPA, scraping, mass-message, artificial activity, or unsupported webhook/API is used
Parsing failure or missing data remains unknown and cannot create a fake order/message state

features.title: Fiverr Draft and Official-Interface Handoff
features.description: Prepare response, custom-offer, order-plan, deadline, extension, and delivery drafts with Team Account attribution and a secure checklist/copy/open handoff to Fiverr's official interface.
acceptance: Every draft is clearly not sent until a human/provider reconciliation records the official action
Handoff includes exact content, attachments, target reference, attribution, checklist, and expiry without transferring credentials
Team member attribution and role limitations are displayed and audited
No automated Fiverr message, offer, gig mutation, order action, or delivery path exists in v1

features.title: Prompt Injection and Artifact Safety Pipeline
features.description: Treat provider/client text, links, files, repository content, logs, and model output as untrusted; isolate parsing and block instruction injection, secret exfiltration, unsafe destinations, and malicious artifacts.
acceptance: Untrusted content cannot change policy, tools, autonomy, recipient, URL, secret scope, retention, or approval
Links and attachments are normalized, scanned, sandboxed/quarantined, and require an allowlisted purpose before retrieval
Malicious fixtures cover indirect prompt injection, hidden text, archive traversal, executable masquerade, SSRF, and secret requests
Detection produces a factual security event and safe operator review without executing embedded instructions

features.title: Retention, Tenant, Replay, and Failure Security Suite
features.description: Build release-blocking integration and property tests for tenant isolation, provider deletion, approval mutation/replay, command signatures, secret boundaries, ambiguous writes, leases/failover, billing deduplication, and kill switches.
acceptance: Tests use real parsers, test HTTP servers, test Postgres/storage, and official provider test modes where available rather than mocked success
All cross-tenant access, stale approval, replay/tamper, secret leak, expired content, duplicate write, and unsafe retry cases fail closed
Time-accelerated deletion and lease tests are deterministic
A failed critical test prevents build promotion and connector write enablement

features.title: Production Observability, SLOs, and Runbooks
features.description: Instrument safe health, metrics, traces, audit continuity, queues, connector capability/terms freshness, deletion lag, approvals, workers, billing reconciliation, proof expiry, and delivery outcomes with operational runbooks.
acceptance: Dashboards and alerts cover the SLOs and failure signals defined in the Delivery Plan without raw provider/client content
Runbooks cover connector revoke/terms change, deletion breach, audit gap, worker compromise, ambiguous write, Stripe discrepancy, and global stop
Synthetic health checks cannot cause external writes or browser activity
Alert delivery failure is observable and never changes an approval decision

features.title: End-to-End Production Canary and Acceptance Evidence
features.description: Run the staged production canary and attach signed evidence for every ClientOps MVP acceptance criterion before broader enablement.
acceptance: A signed iPhone approval dispatches a scoped task to Mac, fails over safely to Windows where eligible, and returns a verified receipt
A bounded operator-authored Upwork search reaches neutral brief, truthful packet, exact approval, provider confirmation, receipt, and on-time deletion without ranking or browser automation
A Direct lead reaches recommendation, accepted proposal/scope, Stripe payment, fulfillment, acceptance, delivery, reconciliation, and contribution-margin reporting
A Fiverr notification reaches attributable draft and official-interface handoff without automated marketplace action
No critical/high finding, unauthorized/duplicate action, unsupported claim, cross-tenant event, secret leak, failed retention deadline, or missing audit link remains
Operator signs the current terms/capability review and every production acceptance criterion has a linked test or signed receipt
